references.text: Abraham asks his servant to place his hand under his thigh and swear – the direct instruction that the servant carries out in verse 9.
Jacob asks Joseph to swear by placing his hand under his thigh, a similar oath practice that Abraham used with his servant.
Jacob swears by the God of his father Isaac – an example of solemn oaths in the patriarchal narratives.
Abram raises his hand and swears before the Lord – Abraham's own practice of making solemn oaths.
Direct narrative context: Abraham gives the instruction in 24:2, which the servant carries out in 24:9.
